reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because the presenter actively promotes joining an investment program through his referral link, claims that it “really really works,” and advertises returns of up to eight percent per month. The instructions describe a binary left/right structure requiring multiple accounts, 31 coins, and referrals to earn affiliate and referral fees, making recruitment-dependent income central to the solicitation. The video also tells viewers that an account must be funded with at least one DNC to activate it, despite the description presenting the opportunity as free to try.

opening.argument: The presentation does not state that returns are guaranteed or risk-free. The speaker explicitly presents the material for viewers to evaluate for themselves, saying they can decide whether to join. The claimed monthly figure is also expressly qualified as fluctuating because gold prices fluctuate. That is investment commentary about a gold-linked platform, with uncertainty acknowledged, rather than a promise of fixed earnings. The description likewise identifies the subject as a decentralized gold trading platform combining gold-price stability with blockchain security, and expressly distinguishes it from high-yield schemes.

citations.quote: you can decide whether you would like to join it
it fluctuates why why does it fluctuate because gold prices fluctuate right
A decentralized gold trading platform combining the stability of gold price and the technological security of blockchain network
Not HYIP Not High Yield

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution treats every mention of referrals and a monthly figure as proof of deception, but its own quotations show the return is qualified as fluctuating. “Really really works” is the speaker’s personal experience, not a guarantee to every viewer. The cited binary explanation describes a structure, but does not by itself establish that the platform is fraudulent or that earnings are assured.

citations.quote: it fluctuates why why does it fluctuate because gold prices fluctuate right
I've already cashed in 2 months I've also cashed in my affiliate programs and my referral programs so it really really works

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The qualifications do not remove the solicitation. The speaker still invites viewers to join through a personal link, reports personal earnings, and describes recurring compensation. Calling the return variable addresses volatility, not whether the underlying opportunity is legitimate. The description’s denial that it is a high-yield scheme is an unsupported characterization, while the video itself supplies the referral and affiliate model.

opening.argument: The video is substantially an explanation and walkthrough of how the platform operates. The speaker says he will explain the theory, shows the platform’s technology and security sections, discusses blockchain record-keeping, and walks through registration and activation. The supplied frames likewise show a platform homepage describing decentralized gold trading, a dashboard with gold-price data and crypto-asset fields, and an account registration form. Those are observable educational and operational demonstrations; explaining how an interface and business model work is not the same as certifying every claim or guaranteeing an outcome.

citations.quote: let me give you a theory behind it and what it all about

record-keeping is transparent

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution relies on selected tutorial steps while ignoring their instructional setting. Explaining a binary layout, account activation, and cash-out methods can be a demonstration of the system’s workflow without proving the presenter is making a deceptive claim. The reference quotations establish what the speaker discussed, but not that the dashboard, blockchain, or gold-related service is fictitious.

citations.quote: let me show you a few things and how we can go about or how do we do and purchase

true_side_reply.rebuttal: This is not merely neutral instruction. The walkthrough is embedded in an invitation to sign up through the speaker’s link and explains how referrals and multiple accounts produce compensation. Demonstrating registration makes participation actionable; it does not neutralize the promotional purpose. The dashboard only shows an interface, not that the promised trading or earnings are genuine.

opening.argument: The material can be read as promotion of a specific gold-related digital service and its operating interface. It describes buying gold-linked products through distributors and presents a dashboard with price information, account fields, assets, and trading-related records. The evidence does not establish that the platform is merely collecting deposits for redistribution, that returns are guaranteed, or that viewers must recruit others to receive ordinary service access. A referral incentive may accompany a commercial platform without converting the entire presentation into proof of a scam.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution’s strongest points show that referrals exist, but they do not show that referral participation is the only product or that the gold-related service is a sham. The cited activation statement establishes an account condition, not where funds go or what an eventual transaction produces. The evidence also lacks a guaranteed-return statement, a promise of inevitable profit, or proof that no underlying asset or service exists.

what they're doing is they're actually tying up with distributors around the world

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The commercial description does not answer the central recruitment mechanism. The speaker recommends a binary arrangement, three accounts, and a 31-coin grouping that generates referral and affiliate fees. The need to put one DNC into an account also shows participation is not simply free product browsing. A dashboard and claims about distributors are presentation features, not independent proof that the advertised commerce or assets exist.
